Appearance

Tall half-elf with salt-streaked hair, permanent squint, and a ledger always in hand. Weather-beaten from years on the water.

What We Know

Harbormaster of Ardenville. Oversees the Merchants Guild Warehouse and all dock operations. Knows every crew, cargo, and hidden inlet of Lake Arden. Fair but inflexible with paperwork.

First Impressions

Meticulous and no-nonsense. If your manifest doesn't match your cargo, expect questions.
